trip.title: Darjeeling Escape
trip.subtitle: Sunrise over Kanchenjunga, toy trains and tea gardens — the Queen of Hills at slow pace.
trip.highlights: ["Tiger Hill sunrise over Kanchenjunga at 4am","Ghoom Monastery — oldest in Darjeeling","Toy train ride — UNESCO World Heritage","Tea garden walk and tasting session","Batasia Loop viewpoint","Lamahatta eco park and pine forest"]
trip.included: ["NJP pickup and drop","All local cab transfers","Hotel or guesthouse stay","Breakfast daily","Tiger Hill sunrise trip","All sightseeing and entry tickets"]
trip.notIncluded: ["Train or flight to NJP","Toy train ticket — ₹1,000 optional add-on","Personal expenses","Meals beyond breakfast"]
trip.faqs: [{"q":"Is flight or train to NJP included?","a":"No — travel to NJP is not included. We recommend booking a train from Kolkata or Delhi to NJP."},{"q":"What fitness level is required?","a":"Easy — suitable for all ages. Tiger Hill requires an early 4am start but no trekking."},{"q":"Best time to visit Darjeeling?","a":"March to June and September to November for clear Kanchenjunga views. Avoid monsoon July to August."},{"q":"Is toy train included?","a":"Toy train is optional at ₹1,000 extra — we help you book it on ground."},{"q":"What is the cancellation policy?","a":"₹2,000 advance to confirm. Full refund if cancelled 10+ days before. 50% refund for 5-9 days."}]
